entities.name: Kynurenine 3-monooxygenase
observations: Reviewed Neurospora crassa UniProt Q7S3C9 annotates hydroxylation of L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine; EC 1.14.13.9; cofactor FAD.
Query sequence has 56.7–67.6% identity to fungal KMO references over approximately 61–65% of its full length; KMO identification is homology-based.

entities.name: KMO oxidation of kynurenine
observations: RHEA:20545 / EC 1.14.13.9: L-kynurenine + NADPH + O2 + H+ = 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + NADP+ + H2O; reference KMO uses FAD.
